introduction:
Here you'll find chip ID information for the Mac mini (2024). Check out our [link|https://youtu.be/rtdGxBeSkz8|Mac mini (2024)|new_window=true] teardown for more details.

''Special thanks to our community member [link|https://www.ifixit.com/User/3536909/CChin|Chunglin Chin|new_window=true] for contributing to this guide!''
